chunks: Ghayb al-Tusi: A group, from Abi Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh and his brother Abi Abdallah al-Husayn ibn Ali, from Abi Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Aswad (may Allah have mercy on him), who said:

Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh (may Allah be pleased with him) asked me – after the death of Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amri (may his spirit be sanctified) – to request Aba al-Qasim al-Ruhi (may Allah sanctify his spirit) to ask our Master, the Master of the Age (peace be upon him), to supplicate to Allah that He grant him a male child.

He said: I asked him but he refused it. Then he informed me after three days that he had supplicated for Ali ibn al-Husayn (may Allah have mercy on him), for a blessed son will be born to him through whom Allah will benefit [people], and after him other sons…
He said: Muhammad ibn Ali was born to Ali ibn al-Husayn (may Allah be pleased with him) that same year, and after him other children…

Abu Ja'far ibn Babawayh said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Aswad would often say to me – when he saw me going to the study session of our Shaykh Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) and feeling motivated towards the books of knowledge and memorizing them: it is not strange that you have this desire for knowledge, for you were born because of the supplication of the Imam (peace be upon him).

key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: May Allah have mercy on him

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Imam's supplication for the birth of Shaykh al-Saduq?
ai.summary: This narrative from Ghayb al-Tusi recounts how Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh requested the Imam of the Age to supplicate for a male child. The Imam's supplication was accepted, resulting in the birth of Muhammad ibn Ali (al-Saduq), whose deep love for knowledge is attributed to this ancestral du'a. The text highlights the Shia belief in the intercessory power of the Imam's prayers to shape the spiritual and intellectual destiny of the learned class, linking the birth of the great hadith scholar to divine decree.

en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/250] Ghayba of al-Tusi: A large number from Abi Ja’far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh and his brother Abi Abdallah al-Husayn b. Ali both of them from Abu Ja’far Muhammad b. Ali al-Aswad رحمه الله who said:

Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh رضي الله عنه asked me – after the death of Muhammad b. Uthman al-Amri قدس سره – to request Aba al-Qasim al-Ruhi قدس سره to implore our Leader the Master of the Age عليه السلام to supplicate to Allah that He grant him a male child.

He [al-Aswad] says: I asked him [al-Ruhi] but he refused it. Then he informed me after three days that he [the Imam] had supplicated for Ali b. al-Husayn رحمه الله and ‘will be born to him a blessed son through whom Allah will benefit many and after him other sons’.
He [al-Aswad] said: Muhammad b. Ali was born to Ali b. al-Husayn رضي الله عنه that same year and after him other children …

Abu Ja’far b. Babawayh (al-Saduq) said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad b. Ali al-Aswad would always say to me – when he sees me going to the study session of our Shaykh Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. al-Walid رضي الله عنه and after observing my motivation for studying the books of knowledge and gaining mastery over them: it is not strange that you have this desire for knowledge for you were born because of the supplication of the Imam عليه السلام.
